Every one of these had drifted: Number('  ') is 0 in JavaScript so a whitespace target meant every offer was an ACCEPT while Python fell back to 25; float() takes '1e3' and '1_0' and parseFloat does not; and Infinity and NaN were guarded out of doubt() in JavaScript and compared against the bounds in Python.
